result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names instead of fixed literals, so renaming a scope aspect no longer stops it or `git-history.zip` from being written. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or an export, so the renamed-aspect case itself is unchecked.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. A new helper, `aspectZipEntry(aspect)`, builds the file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call that writes the loose `data/text/aspect_<name>.txt` files. It then reads that file and returns it as the zip entry. The zip is built from the main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other aspects, in that order.

With the default configuration the entries keep their current names and order. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. I expect `git-history.zip` to be written again too, since it was only skipped because the earlier lookup threw.
